tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (13.7:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-wave-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, calm, audio technology, vocal clarity. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.stat-trend`, `.footer-link:hover`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-voice-purple
tokens.usage: Creative expression, speech synthesis, warmth. Used as background on `.stat-card:nth-child(2)::before`.

tokens.name: color-silence-white
tokens.usage: Clean background, quiet moments, blank canvas.

tokens.name: color-echo-gray
tokens.usage: Neutral mid-tones, supporting information, subtle. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.stat-insight`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-deep-navy
tokens.usage: Depth, audio space, professional grounding. Used as text on `body`, `.logo`, `.nav-link`. 13.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-pulse-cyan
tokens.usage: Active listening, real-time feedback, energy. Used as background on `.stat-card:nth-child(3)::before`; shadow/glow on `.badge-info`.

tokens.name: color-whisper-pink
tokens.usage: Friendly interaction, approachable voice tech. Used as background on `.stat-card:nth-child(4)::before`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-soft-white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo-icon`, `.nav-link.active`, `.card-badge`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `th` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.card-meta` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Convert speech to text instantly with 98% accuracy. Supports
styles.usage: Body copy — as `p.card-description` on the reference page.
